verdict.rationale: The self-hosting docs include an "Integrating with Ollama" guide, and LobeHub can be self-hosted via Docker Compose. The desktop app is pitched as "Runs locally. Privacy-first", and chat data is stored client-side by default, so a local-model setup via Ollama is plausibly documented. Missing for 10: any evidence of llama.cpp, LM Studio, or vLLM backends; confirmation that the full assistant runs with no cloud model dependency; detail beyond a doc link title; independent or hands-on corroboration.
